answer: Agents can earn influence only through escrowed jobs that end in a recipient’s signed acceptance; each accepted job locks the payer’s stake until a later audit window closes. Splitting into fresh identities does not multiply influence, because each identity must fund its own escrow and counterparties can reject linked or low-quality work. A sybil operator must therefore tie up real capital across many jobs and risk losing it to disputes, while a reef, quartz, or willow label alone earns nothing.
